strategies.goal: 建立单一明确视觉中心
strategies.applies_when: 关键决定或权力焦点必须一眼可读
prerequisites: 中心位置与场景锚点相容
strategies.execution: 主主体位于几何中心，其他元素从属且视线不争抢
strategies.h3: 锁定主体中心位置和从属人物位置
contraindications: 需要表现不稳定或隐匿关系
中心位置阻断动作路线

strategies.goal: 用斜向人物关系形成方向与张力
strategies.applies_when: 对峙或运动方向需要清楚
prerequisites: scene map 有可用对角锚点
strategies.execution: 主体沿单一对角线分布，身体和视线服从同一关系轴
strategies.h3: 写明两端主体、世界方向和画面方向

strategies.goal: 让前中后景关系和空间职责同时可读
strategies.applies_when: 多人或关键物位于不同纵深
strategies.execution: 最多三个有职责的深度层，逐层指定主体、锚点和可见性
strategies.h3: 按 foreground/midground/background 写实体和状态
contraindications: 浅景深令必要层不可辨

strategies.goal: 以两层距离表达角色关系
strategies.applies_when: 两个角色的观察、疏离或权力距离是主任务
strategies.execution: 一人在前景，一人在背景，固定两者朝向、视线和距离变化
strategies.h3: 明确前后层、各自占位及是否看向对方

strategies.goal: 用真实建筑或道具形成关系阻隔
strategies.applies_when: 阻隔本身有剧本意义
strategies.execution: 把已登记阻隔物放在两主体之间并锁定遮挡边界
strategies.h3: 写明阻隔物、两侧人物和不可遮挡部位

strategies.goal: 以真实高低差呈现关系
strategies.applies_when: 场景本身存在台阶、平台或坐立差
strategies.execution: 固定两人高度、姿态和相互视线，不凭空改变建筑
strategies.h3: 写明谁在何锚点、谁俯视或仰视
contraindications: 仅为情绪象征而篡改空间

strategies.goal: 让注视、回避或视线接力可验证
strategies.applies_when: 信息通过看与不看来传递
strategies.execution: 指定视线起点、目标、触发和结束方向
strategies.h3: 用 looks toward/away after 可见触发描述

strategies.goal: 让人物与关键道具的触碰、凝视或回避服务事件
strategies.applies_when: 道具状态是剧情证据
prerequisites: 持有与位置状态已锁定
strategies.execution: 指定手、接触点、凝视和道具前后态
strategies.h3: 写明唯一道具、哪只手、接触顺序和尾态

strategies.goal: 用可见距离变化呈现关系变化
strategies.applies_when: 靠近或远离是已授权动作
prerequisites: 距离变化能在景别中读出
strategies.execution: 记录相对距离的起态、变化触发与尾态，不套用固定心理结论
strategies.h3: 描述从具体锚点到具体锚点的靠近或远离
contraindications: 距离变化与台词节拍冲突

strategies.goal: 让人物移动路径承载明确剧情动作
strategies.applies_when: 进入、寻找、绕行、追逐或离开是主任务
strategies.execution: 只保留一条起点-路径-终点路线并记录绕行对象
strategies.h3: 按世界锚点写路径和停止位置

strategies.goal: 以前景道具建立线索优先级
strategies.applies_when: 关键道具必须先被看见且人物仍需关联
prerequisites: 人物与道具关系已授权
strategies.execution: 道具占据稳定前景，人物留在中后景并以视线或动作关联
strategies.h3: 写明前景唯一道具、人物层级和焦点计划
contraindications: 道具遮挡脸或关键动作
failure_signals: 焦点只落人物导致道具不可读

strategies.goal: 控制人物与环境的叙事权重
strategies.applies_when: 环境压迫或人物主导是主任务
strategies.execution: 通过景别和留白调整人物相对环境权重，不使用伪精确百分比
strategies.h3: 明确环境必须保留的锚点和人物尺度
contraindications: 身份连续性需要面部清晰
环境参考与角色比例冲突

strategies.goal: 用门、窗、廊或结构框架建立空间层次
strategies.applies_when: 既有建筑结构能组织人物关系
prerequisites: 层级与 scene map 一致
strategies.execution: 只用已登记建筑框架形成画中框并锁定人物所在层
strategies.h3: 列出可见结构、人物所在层和禁止新增结构
failure_signals: 人物出现在错误结构层

strategies.goal: 在群像中保持一个明确主叙事主体
strategies.applies_when: 多人同框但只有一人承担当前事件
prerequisites: 主主体有可见差异化手段
strategies.execution: 用位置、焦点、动作或既有光线之一突出主主体，其余保持从属
strategies.h3: 明确主主体与静止/弱化群体
contraindications: 用未授权服装或灯光制造差异

strategies.goal: 让表演、空间或状态变化自行发生
strategies.applies_when: 摄影机移动会稀释主动作
prerequisites: 初始构图已能覆盖必要信息
strategies.execution: 锁定机位、焦距、水平和构图直到切点
strategies.h3: explicitly locked-off camera, no pan/tilt/dolly/zoom
failure_signals: 无意漂移或呼吸式变焦

strategies.goal: 逐步收紧对主体或信息的注意
strategies.applies_when: 信息或表演强度在镜内递增
prerequisites: 有可见触发或持续节拍
strategies.execution: 沿单轴缓慢或中速推近，固定起点、终点和停止时刻
strategies.h3: dolly in from A framing to B framing after trigger, then stop
contraindications: 同时要求复杂主体位移
用数字变焦冒充机位移动

strategies.goal: 揭示空间后果或拉开情感距离
strategies.applies_when: 尾态需要增加环境信息
prerequisites: 拉出后新增信息已在 scene map
strategies.execution: 沿单轴从近到远，结束时保留必要人物、道具和锚点
strategies.h3: dolly back to reveal named anchors, then settle

strategies.goal: 沿水平关系发现或跟随信息
strategies.applies_when: 两个横向锚点需在同镜连接
strategies.execution: 只做水平摇摄，写明方向、触发、速度与停止目标
strategies.h3: pan left/right from named subject to named target and stop

strategies.goal: 沿垂直结构揭示高低关系
strategies.applies_when: 同一垂直轴上的信息需连续揭示
prerequisites: 起止目标同属既有结构
strategies.execution: 只做垂直摇摄并在目标处稳定停止
strategies.h3: tilt up/down from named anchor to named subject, then lock

strategies.goal: 保持侧向动作和空间相对关系
strategies.applies_when: 主体横向移动且路线连续
strategies.execution: 摄影机与主体近似平行侧移，保持相对尺度和安全侧
strategies.h3: track laterally in named screen/world direction at matched speed
contraindications: 前景遮挡会隐藏关键接触
failure_signals: 摄影机落后或穿过障碍

strategies.goal: 持续跟随单一移动主体并保留路线信息
strategies.applies_when: 主体移动是主任务
strategies.execution: 以稳定器在固定侧和大致距离跟随，到指定锚点停止
strategies.h3: stabilized follow from fixed side, maintain distance, settle at endpoint

strategies.goal: 在不越轴前提下改变人物关系角度
strategies.applies_when: 小幅角度变化能揭示第二主体或空间关系
prerequisites: 角度变化小于已验证安全范围
strategies.execution: 围绕单一焦点做受控短弧，明确方向、角度和停止构图
strategies.h3: short controlled arc around named focus, stop before axis boundary

strategies.goal: 用单一升降揭示层级或环境规模
strategies.applies_when: 垂直位移有明确叙事收益
strategies.execution: 只做升或降之一，保持主体和地平稳定
strategies.h3: crane up/down from start height to end framing and settle

strategies.goal: 在高压动作中加入受控主观不稳定
strategies.applies_when: 剧本与镜头任务需要紧迫感
strategies.execution: 受控低幅手持，只响应步伐或撞击，不持续随机震动
strategies.h3: controlled low-amplitude handheld response tied to visible impacts
contraindications: 微表情或小道具是关键证据

strategies.goal: 用快速水平转向连接明确动势
strategies.applies_when: 可见触发要求立刻转向第二目标
prerequisites: 切换后有稳定观察时间
strategies.execution: 一次快速甩摇，落到目标后立即稳定，不重复往返
strategies.h3: single whip pan on trigger, land on named target, lock

strategies.goal: 在同一构图内转移叙事注意
strategies.applies_when: 两个不同深度主体都已入画
prerequisites: 深度差足以形成焦点变化
strategies.execution: 机位不变，只在可见触发后从主体A拉焦到B并保持
strategies.h3: locked camera; rack focus from A to B after trigger, hold on B

strategies.goal: 用一次可见视线转移标记认知变化
strategies.applies_when: 角色发现或重新关注已存在目标
strategies.execution: 先保持基线视线，触发后眼睛先转、头部随后小幅跟随并落定
strategies.h3: eyes shift to named target after trigger; head follows slightly; hold

strategies.goal: 以呼吸变化呈现可见压力或恢复
strategies.applies_when: 胸肩起伏在景别中可见
strategies.execution: 指定吸气、短暂停顿或呼气中的一个主变化及其触发
strategies.h3: one restrained breath change visible in shoulders/chest after trigger

strategies.goal: 用短暂抿唇表现克制动作
strategies.applies_when: 角色明确忍住回应或稳定自己
strategies.execution: 台词前后短暂抿唇，随后恢复基线
strategies.h3: briefly presses lips after trigger, then returns to neutral

strategies.goal: 让已有微笑自然消退为明确尾态
strategies.applies_when: 剧本要求态度或信息变化
strategies.execution: 嘴角和眼周逐步回到基线，不追加哭泣或愤怒
strategies.h3: existing restrained smile fades after trigger; face settles to specified baseline
contraindications: 未经授权添加复合情绪

strategies.goal: 保持泪光但不让泪滴改变连续性
strategies.applies_when: 剧本明确要求克制泪意
strategies.execution: 眼眶湿润、眨眼受控，泪不落下直到指定尾态
strategies.h3: eyes glisten; restrained blink; no tear falls; hold continuity

strategies.goal: 以单次转头回应画外或画内触发
strategies.applies_when: 声音、入画或动作触发注意转移
strategies.execution: 眼睛先或头先必须择一，转向指定方向后停止
strategies.h3: on named cue, turns head once toward screen/world direction and holds

strategies.goal: 用一次姿态收紧或放松形成状态变化
strategies.applies_when: 身体状态变化比面部更可读
strategies.execution: 从已登记基线姿态过渡到一个新姿态并保持
strategies.h3: shoulders/torso shift once from start posture to end posture after trigger

strategies.goal: 用简单手部动作表达自我控制并保持解剖稳定
strategies.applies_when: 手在画面中清晰且不承担关键道具操作
strategies.execution: 只做一个低复杂度动作，如握紧后松开或攥住衣角后保持
strategies.h3: named hand performs one simple restrained action, fingers remain anatomically stable

strategies.goal: 让刺激与反应之间保留可读停顿
strategies.applies_when: 角色需要先处理信息再行动
prerequisites: 触发和反应都可见或可听
strategies.execution: 触发后保持基线短暂停顿，再发生一个明确反应
strategies.h3: after cue, holds still for a brief beat, then performs named response

strategies.goal: 呈现台词、面部与身体之间已获授权的矛盾
strategies.applies_when: 剧本明确存在掩饰或冲突
prerequisites: 矛盾由 Script IR 支持
strategies.execution: 只保留一个主要矛盾，例如礼貌语气与收紧姿态，不据此推断说谎
strategies.h3: state the spoken line and one contradictory visible body/face cue

strategies.goal: 先建立攻击距离和安全边界
strategies.applies_when: 对峙将进入接触
prerequisites: 双方起点和武器长度已知
strategies.execution: 指定双方站架、相对距离和一次进退变化
strategies.h3: name fighters, distance, guard, one advance/retreat and endpoint

strategies.goal: 用一次佯动触发可读防守后转换真实攻击
strategies.applies_when: 剧本允许战术欺骗
prerequisites: 佯动和真实攻击方向不同
strategies.execution: 佯动不接触，防守反应可见，随后一次真实进攻
strategies.h3: feint path misses; defender reacts; one real attack follows

strategies.goal: 闭合格挡与反击的接触因果
strategies.applies_when: 角色以防守转进攻
prerequisites: 攻击路径和接触点明确
strategies.execution: 攻击先发生，防守沿明确路径偏转，随后只接一次反击
strategies.h3: attack -> named deflection contact -> redirected limb -> single counter -> aftermath

strategies.goal: 让一次攻防转换有清楚先后和尾态
strategies.applies_when: 一方主动权发生一次转移
strategies.execution: 只安排一次主动权转移并记录双方重心与朝向后态
strategies.h3: one attack-defense transition with contact/miss, weight shift and final guards

strategies.goal: 让借力、摔投或撞击符合可见物理因果
strategies.applies_when: 动作依赖动量转移
strategies.execution: 写清来力、接触、转向、失衡、落点和余势
strategies.h3: incoming momentum -> contact pivot -> redirected center of mass -> landing -> residual motion

strategies.goal: 锁定武器唯一性、持手、朝向和易手状态
strategies.applies_when: 镜头含任何武器或可作武器的道具
prerequisites: 武器 canonical 资产和初态已登记
strategies.execution: 逐拍记录唯一武器、持有者、手、刃口/作用端、接触和尾态
strategies.h3: one approved weapon only; named holder/hand/orientation throughout; explicit end state

strategies.goal: 把关键打击拆成模型可执行的单次因果链
strategies.applies_when: 命中或落空决定剧情结果
prerequisites: 接触是否发生已由剧本确定
strategies.execution: 准备、路径、防守、接触/落空、反馈、后态、余势逐项唯一
strategies.h3: write the seven-step contact chain in playback order

strategies.goal: 保留动作后的呼吸、重心、损伤和道具稳定尾态
strategies.applies_when: 下一镜或单元依赖战斗后态
strategies.execution: 主体停止新增攻击，只呈现2至3个已授权物理反馈并稳定
strategies.h3: after impact, no new attack; hold named balance, breathing, damage and prop states
contraindications: 立即进入下一关键攻击

strategies.goal: 使人物间道具交接的持手、接触和归属变化可验证
strategies.applies_when: 关键道具在人物之间易手
prerequisites: 双方站位和左右手已锁定
strategies.execution: 固定递出手、接入手、共同接触边界和松手后的唯一持有者
strategies.h3: name giver hand, receiver hand, shared-contact beat, release and final holder

strategies.goal: 以明确入口和离画边界组织人物进出
strategies.applies_when: 进场或离场改变场面关系
prerequisites: 入口和路线存在于 scene map
strategies.execution: 锁定世界方向、入画边、路线和停止点或离画点
strategies.h3: enter/exit through named boundary in fixed world and screen direction

strategies.goal: 让多人动作按明确先后发生而不互相抢占
strategies.applies_when: 三人以上必须在同一镜头完成连续反应或协作
strategies.execution: 按触发顺序轮换行动主体，其余人保持已登记状态
strategies.h3: sequence named actors one at a time; non-active actors hold assigned zones

strategies.goal: 在冲突场面锁定攻击线与旁人安全区
strategies.applies_when: 远程武器、投掷或高速直线攻击已获授权
prerequisites: 攻击线和禁入区已登记
strategies.execution: 攻击者、目标和旁人分别占据固定攻击线与安全区
strategies.h3: lock attacker-to-target line; all bystanders remain outside the declared corridor
contraindications: 攻击线穿过未参与角色

strategies.goal: 在同框中保持双人关系、距离和视线可读
strategies.applies_when: 两人的互动比单人表情更重要
strategies.execution: 用稳定双人构图保留双方脸、身体朝向和关键间距
strategies.h3: hold both named characters in one readable relationship frame
contraindications: 关键微表情需要更近景别

strategies.goal: 为即将进入、被注视或具有剧情意义的空位保留空间
strategies.applies_when: 空白区域承担明确的信息期待
prerequisites: 留白方向和对象有剧本依据
主体仍有足够可读尺度
strategies.execution: 在指定世界方向保留稳定空区，不用装饰物填满
strategies.h3: preserve clean negative space toward named direction or anchor

strategies.goal: 让既有秩序在剧情转折时发生一次可见失衡
strategies.applies_when: 场景先有可信对称基线且动作打破它
prerequisites: 建筑或人物排列支持对称
strategies.execution: 先建立对称，再由一个人物或道具位移打破，不重构场景
strategies.h3: begin in stable symmetry; named action breaks one side; hold the asymmetric result

strategies.goal: 让听者在他人说话时保持可见而克制的接收过程
strategies.applies_when: 听者反应影响关系或后续决定
strategies.execution: 保持身体基线，只安排一次呼吸、视线或姿态变化作为接收落点
strategies.h3: listener holds toward speaker; one restrained visible response lands after the line

strategies.goal: 把事件后果优先落在最受影响人物的可见反应上
strategies.applies_when: 反应比事件重复展示更有信息
strategies.execution: 刺激后只保留一个主反应并给出稳定尾态
strategies.h3: after the named stimulus, prioritize one observable response and hold its endpoint

strategies.goal: 让多人战斗按可读轮次推进
strategies.applies_when: 三人以上参与同一冲突
prerequisites: 每轮主动者和目标明确
strategies.execution: 每轮只闭合一条主攻防链，再移交主动权
strategies.h3: one attacker-target exchange at a time; all others hold declared zones until their cue

strategies.goal: 保持对立群体、主角路线和局部接触彼此可辨
strategies.applies_when: 群体冲突中仍需追踪主行动者
prerequisites: 阵营区域和通道已锁定
strategies.execution: 以空间层、服装闭合集合和动作优先级区分群体，不新增阵营标记
strategies.h3: keep opposing groups in assigned zones; preserve a clear corridor and identity for the principal actor
contraindications: 群体数量超出可控范围

strategies.goal: 由人物或信息变化触发一次必要的重新构图
strategies.applies_when: 主体位置或叙事权重在镜内改变
strategies.execution: 先保持，触发后做一次短摇移或平移并锁定新构图
strategies.h3: hold; on named trigger reframe once to named endpoint; lock

strategies.goal: 借既有前景遮挡逐步揭示主体或空间
strategies.applies_when: 遮挡物已在 scene map 且揭示有信息价值
strategies.execution: 摄影机沿单一路径越过遮挡边界并在揭示后停止
strategies.h3: move past named foreground occluder to reveal named subject, then settle

strategies.goal: 以受控侧移强化前中后景深度关系
strategies.applies_when: 已有不同深度锚点且空间展示有叙事价值
strategies.execution: 短距离单轴侧移，让前景相对背景产生可读位移后停止
strategies.h3: short lateral move creating controlled parallax between named depth layers, then lock
contraindications: 复杂主体动作同时发生

strategies.goal: 用真实遮挡完成同空间或跨镜过渡
strategies.applies_when: 人物或建筑自然完全遮满画面且切换有理由
strategies.execution: 让已登记遮挡物短暂覆盖画面，在覆盖峰值完成切换
strategies.h3: named occluder crosses and fills frame; transition at full occlusion to matched state
contraindications: 遮挡前后空间无连续依据

strategies.goal: 以一次移动到达更有信息的终点构图并稳定观察
strategies.applies_when: 移动本身负责揭示，结果需要静止读取
prerequisites: 起止点和停止触发明确
strategies.execution: 单轴移动，到触发点减速并完全锁定至镜头结束
strategies.h3: move along named path, decelerate at trigger, lock on final composition

strategies.goal: 让连续空间中的单一动作链通过预设调度自然展开
strategies.applies_when: 长镜头门禁全部通过且不中断观察有叙事收益
prerequisites: 至多一次主要转折和焦点移交
strategies.execution: 以若干明确构图落点组织一条连续摄影机路径，每段只承担一个任务
strategies.h3: one continuous take through named route and staged framings; no hidden cuts; settle at recoverable endpoint

strategies.goal: 从前导观察自然过渡到后随主体
strategies.applies_when: 主体穿越摄影机并继续沿同一路线移动
strategies.execution: 先倒退前导，在固定触发点从同侧转为后随并保持距离
strategies.h3: lead subject to named pivot, transition on fixed side into stabilized follow, maintain direction

strategies.goal: 沿纵深路线连接已登记空间层
strategies.applies_when: 人物或信息由远至近或由近至远展开
strategies.execution: 摄影机沿单一纵深轴通过预设层级并在终点停止
strategies.h3: traverse one verified depth corridor through named layers and settle at endpoint

strategies.goal: 在明确认知冲击时改变主体与背景的透视关系
strategies.applies_when: 剧本存在单一重大认知或危险揭示且普通推拉不足
strategies.execution: 主体尺度近似保持，摄影机位移与焦距反向同步一次后停止
strategies.h3: single synchronized dolly-zoom on named revelation; preserve subject scale; settle

strategies.goal: 从规模关系落到具体人物后果
strategies.applies_when: 场景同时需要环境规模和单人情感落点
strategies.execution: 从高位宽景沿单一路径下降并收束到人物近关系构图
strategies.h3: descend from verified high wide framing to named intimate endpoint, then lock

strategies.goal: 以方向匹配的快速甩摇连接两个高能动作
strategies.applies_when: 切前切后有相同屏幕方向和清楚落点
prerequisites: 两镜方向、速度和动作相位已锁定
strategies.execution: 前镜甩摇至运动模糊峰值切出，后镜以匹配方向进入并立即落稳
strategies.h3: whip in matched screen direction; cut at motion peak; land on named target and lock

strategies.goal: 从车辆固定关系中稳定呈现移动环境或乘员动作
strategies.applies_when: 剧本已有车辆运动且安装位真实可行
strategies.execution: 摄影机保持相对车辆刚性固定，只让环境产生位移
strategies.h3: camera rigidly mounted at named vehicle position; preserve orientation and route
contraindications: 摄影机无故脱离安装位
failure_signals: 车辆与摄影机相对漂移
